noeuds.role: Waits for the chosen time, in seconds, then continues. The rest of the game keeps running during the wait.
noeuds.exemple: show “You lose!”, wait 2 seconds, then restart the scene.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Every (seconds), Number of times (0 = endless), Timer name (optional)  →  Outputs: Right away / Each time / Move finished
noeuds.role: Runs the “Each time” output every X seconds, a number of times (0 = forever), then “Move finished”. “Right away” runs at the start. If it is already running, it does not start again.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Object, Variable, Start value (optional), Timer name (optional)  →  Outputs: Every second / Move finished
noeuds.role: Removes 1 from the chosen variable (a number) every second until 0. “Every second” runs on each tick, “Move finished” at 0. “Start value (optional)” sets the starting value.
Stops the timer (Repeat or Countdown) with this name, or all timers if the name is empty.
noeuds.exemple: stop the timer when the player wins.

noeuds.role: Changes the speed of the whole game: 1 = normal, 0.5 = slow motion, 2 = fast (from 0 to 4).
Pauses the game: movements and timers stop.
Resumes the game after a pause.
noeuds.exemple: the “Continue” button of the pause menu.

noeuds.schema: Inputs: Duration (seconds), Speed during the stop (0 = frozen)
noeuds.role: Slows the whole game almost to a stop for a very short moment (in real seconds), then the game goes back to its speed. It gives “punch” to impacts.
noeuds.exemple: when an enemy explodes: duration 0.06, speed 0.05.
